title: TRACK: Tool-Augmented Reasoning over Time Series for Fault Diagnosis in Power Management System
abstract: arXiv:2611.21178v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fault diagnosis in power management systems running multiple loads relies on experts manually inspecting current and voltage waveforms, which fails to scale across deployed units. We present TRACK, which pairs a time series encoder with a Small Language Model to produce structured, physics-grounded diagnostic reports, calling tools for exact, verifiable calculations. It operates on-device, keeping proprietary sensor data local and avoiding expensive API calls. We introduce a rubric-based framework that evaluates these reports by scoring structure, signal fidelity, physics reasoning, diagnosis, and actionability through per-criterion verdicts. On a 15-class multi-load simulated benchmark, TRACK achieves over 95% fault-category accuracy and generalizes to out-of-distribution faults, whereas the best encoder-probing baseline reaches only 58% accuracy.

translated_title: TRACK：面向电源管理系统故障诊断的工具增强时间序列推理
translated_abstract: 运行多个负载的电源管理系统中的故障诊断目前依赖专家手动检查电流和电压波形，这种方式难以在大量已部署设备上扩展。我们提出了TRACK，它将时间序列编码器与小型语言模型（SLM）相结合，生成结构化、基于物理原理的诊断报告，并通过调用工具进行精确、可验证的计算。该系统在设备端运行，将专有传感器数据保留在本地，同时避免了昂贵的API调用费用。我们引入了一个基于评分细则的评估框架，通过逐项评判结构、信号保真度、物理推理、诊断和可操作性等准则来评估这些报告。在一个15类多负载模拟基准上，TRACK实现了超过95%的故障类别准确率，并能泛化到分布外故障，而最好的编码器探测基线仅达到58%的准确率。
tldr: TRACK将时间序列编码器与小型语言模型结合，通过工具调用实现精确可验证的计算，在设备端生成基于物理原理的结构化故障诊断报告，在15类多负载基准上达到超过95%的准确率并显著超越基线。
en_tdlr: TRACK pairs a time series encoder with a small language model that calls tools for exact, verifiable calculations to generate physics-grounded diagnostic reports on-device, achieving over 95% fault-category accuracy on a 15-class multi-load benchmark versus 58% for the best baseline.
